title: Burnt electric smell
text: Burnt electric smell. Bought this while my kitchen aid is out and it can’t even cream room temp butter and sugar without smelling like smoke. Easy to use but .. the motor clearly can’t handle a lot.

product_metadata.title: Magnolia Bakery 5-Speed Electric Hand Mixer by Hamilton Beach, Powerful 1.3 Amp DC Motor for Effortless Mixing & Consistent Speed in Thick Ingredients, Slow Start, Beaters and Whisk, Green (62601)
features: EASILY CREATE MAGNOLIA BAKERY DESSERTS & YOUR OWN FAVORITES. Fans of Magnolia Bakery can bring home a symbol of the bakery's nostalgic charm with this vintage-style hand mixer. It helps you create delicious desserts and memories in your own home.

EFFORTLESS MIXING AND CONTROL WITH POWERFUL DC MOTOR. Besides mixing and whipping dessert, the powerful, professional-grade DC motor takes on everything from whipped cream to mashed potatoes with ease. Despite its power, the DC motor runs quietly.

SLOW START TECHNOLOGY GRADUALLY INCREASES MIXING SPEED. Prevent clouds of flour or splatters of batter by starting slow. This electric hand mixer's starting speed is nearly half as slow as a traditional mixer, so you can add ingredients gradually.

NO MORE LOST BEATERS — CONVENIENT SNAP-ON STORAGE CASE. Now you can neatly store your attachments in one place with this hand mixer with storage case. Includes 2 traditional stainless steel beaters and whisk.

EASILY HANDLE EVERY MIXING JOB WITH 5 SPEEDS AND QUICKBURST BUTTON. This versatile hand mixer has 5 speeds to handle every mixing job and a QuickBurst button to give you an extra burst of power at any speed.
description: Make Magnolia Bakery desserts and your own favorite recipes at home with this vintage-style Magnolia Bakery Hand Mixer by Hamilton Beach. Its powerful DC motor and 5 speeds provide effortless mixing for cupcakes and more. Storage case included.
